cases.name: summary
inputs: Factorio is a game about building and maintaining factories. The player is an engineer who crash-lands on the planet Nauvis and must mine resources, research technologies, and build automated production lines to launch a rocket into space. The factory grows from a few burner drills into a vast network of conveyor belts, assembling machines, and trains, while the native biters attack the polluting structures. Wube Software released the game in 2020 after eight years of early access.
